subject.title: [Feature]: Add comparative cost windows to Usage

question: Should Control UI Usage add side-by-side Today/7-day/30-day/90-day cost windows and min/mid/max daily chart labels now, using only existing daily usage data?
rationale: The code path is clear, but this is a new operator-facing presentation surface on a protected maintainer-labeled feature request, so automation should wait for maintainer product direction.

options.title: Build UI-only comparison cards
options.body: Add the requested window summaries and scale labels in the Usage UI, with deterministic render tests and before/after screenshots, without backend or storage changes.

options.title: Fold into broader Usage redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer the work until a larger Usage dashboard pass decides the full information architecture.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close or leave deprioritized if maintainers decide the existing range presets and hover tooltips are enough for current operator workflows.

recommendation.title: Build UI-only comparison cards
recommendation.body: Add the requested window summaries and scale labels in the Usage UI, with deterministic render tests and before/after screenshots, without backend or storage changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the product request, merged the current Usage surface, and recently authored adjacent UI cost presentation work.
